narr: Thunderstorms brought heavy rain to southeastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon of June 8. Rainfall totals of 3 to 7 inches were reported in the Brandywine Creek basin of Chester County.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Parkesburg and Sadsburyville. There were numerous water rescues.
The bridge over Harvey Run on Ring Road in Chadds Ford Township was overtopped by flood waters.
A water rescue took place at the intersection of Jefferson Avenue and Green Street in Downingtown.
Moderate flooding occurred along the West Branch of the Brandywine Creek in Modena and East Fallowfield Township.
Major flooding occurred along the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek below Downingtown in West Bradford Township and East Bradford Township.
Widespread roadway flooding occurred in East Brandywine Township and Caln Township. There were numerous water rescues.

Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Valley Township, Coatesville and South Coatesville. There were numerous water rescues. Minor flooding occurred along the West Branch of the Brandywine Creek in and around Coatesville and South Coatesville.
